questions.question: Explain why the Shahadah is the most important Pillar of Islam.

points.text: The Shahadah is the most important Pillar because it sums up the entire Islamic faith: tawhid (one God) and risalah (Muhammad as prophet). Without the Shahadah, none of the other Pillars would make sense — prayer, fasting, charity and pilgrimage all depend on the belief that Allah is the one God and Muhammad is his messenger.
